caregiver.title: Caregiver service
caregiver.subtitle: Professional, qualified care so that everyone can enjoy greater comfort and quality of life.

intro.title: Who is it for?
intro.audience: The caregiver/assistant service is aimed at people with anything from moderate dependency to severe dependency, who need professional, qualified staff for their daily care.
intro.goal: Our main goal is for people to enjoy greater comfort and quality of life, whatever their level of dependency.

autonomy.title: Autonomy and self-esteem
autonomy.text: Helps maintain the highest possible level of autonomy and self-esteem.

companionship.title: Attention and companionship
companionship.text: Looking after the person, going for walks, keeping company, accompanying them to medical appointments, etc.

stimulation.title: Cognitive stimulation
stimulation.text: Helps with basic stimulation exercises to slow cognitive decline, when needed.

hygiene.title: Personal hygiene
hygiene.text: Bed bath or shower, changing clothes and incontinence pads, shaving, hair washing and styling, mouth and lip hygiene, skin care and pressure ulcer prevention.

mobility.title: Mobility support
mobility.text: Getting up and into bed, changes of position and location, and help moving around the home.

nutrition.title: Meals and medication
nutrition.text: Help with eating and with taking medication, making sure it is taken correctly (always with a medical prescription).

home.title: Household support
home.text: Help with household tasks, shopping and meal preparation, with menus adapted to the person's dietary needs.

hospital.title: Hospitals and care homes
hospital.text: Travels to the hospital or care home to cover needs that the institution's basic service cannot: walks, company or anything else required.

schedules.title: Types of working schedule
schedules.intro: We adapt to every need. Choose the arrangement that best suits your situation:

hourly.title: How does the hourly elderly care service work?

minimum.title: From 2 hours a day
minimum.text: Service from 2 hours a day, 5 days a week.

followup.title: Personalised follow-up
followup.text: With psychologists, occupational therapists and social workers.

admin.title: Administration included
admin.text: We take care of hiring, Social Security registration, payroll, etc.

professional.title: The most suitable professional
professional.text: We select the professional who best fits each case.

technology.title: Constantly evolving technology
technology.text: We use technology that is constantly evolving.

assessment.title: Comprehensive assessment and IWP
assessment.text: We carry out a comprehensive assessment and draw up an Individual Work Plan (IWP).

cta.title: We understand your needs
cta.text: Tell us about your case and we will propose the solution that suits you best.
